Media United by a Love of Travel We are a group of passionate individuals around the world with 1,500 employees and 50 nationalities. Never standing still We’re a group of talented, passionate individuals located around the world. Not afraid to innovate or try new things, we're committed to using technology to make the complexities of travel simple. Part of the Trip.com Group family, Skyscanner is operationally independent with big plans for the future of travel. Our culture Every day we are… 1. Thinking traveller first. We love to travel and this is what unites us. 2. Learning, sharing and growing. Different skills, experiences and backgrounds help us develop. 3. Caring, always. Treating each other with empathy and respect. We get it done, together. 4. Making it simple. Building things that make travel easy and accessible. View photos Meet the team leading the change Bryan Batista Chief Executive Officer Bryan is Skyscanner’s CEO, leading our mission to be the world’s top travel ally. Previously our COO, he’s also held senior roles at Booking.com and Tesla. He brings global vision, sharp strategy and a serious love of food to everything he does. Laurence Tracol Chief Financial Officer Laurence is Skyscanner’s CFO, with 25+ years in tech and e-commerce across Europe and Silicon Valley. Formerly at eBay, she drives smart growth, sharp strategy and clear storytelling that connects the numbers to our bigger mission. Piero Sierra Chief AI Officer Piero is leading Skyscanner’s AI revolution, blending deep tech expertise with a traveller-first mindset. With decades of experience at Microsoft and Skyscanner, he’s passionate about using AI to make trip planning effortless—and a little more magical. Martin Nolan Chief Legal Officer Martin leads our Legal, Regulatory and Public Affairs teams, and champions trust and transparency in travel. He’s an industry voice in Europe and North America, and a former corporate lawyer with deep roots in finance, M&A and private equity. Clive Peoples Chief Marketing Officer Clive leads Skyscanner’s global marketing, shaping how millions of travellers see and connect with our brand. With senior roles at eBay and Expedia behind him, he blends creative instinct with performance know-how to make Skyscanner stand out. Caroline Scott Chief People Officer Caroline leads our People Team, blending strategic leadership with a people-first mindset to build clarity, trust and high-performing teams while preserving the warmth that makes Skyscanner a great place to work - driving impact for travellers & partners. Andrew Phillips Chief Technology Officer Andrew joined Skyscanner as a grad and has spent 12 years climbing the engineering ranks. Now CTO, he leads global teams and champions our culture, with a sharp focus on growing the next wave of tech talent and future leaders from within. Ola Sroka VP of Strategy Ola sets Skyscanner’s strategic direction, spotting growth opportunities and keeping us focused and fast. She’s led teams across fintech and tech, with global insight from BCG. Outside work, she’s into Pilates and sleeping under canvas when she can. Cat King Chief Commercial Officer Cat leads Skyscanner’s global commercial teams across flights, hotels and cars. With over 15 years in the travel industry, she’s played a key role in building and shaping the talented team that now supports more than 1,200 partners worldwide. A world of opportunity We’re always on the lookout for brilliant, inquisitive minds to join our team. Sound familiar? We’d love to hear from you.
